## 🐛 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 💻 Environment
- **Operating System**: [e.g. Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04, macOS Sonoma]
- **Python Version**: [e.g. 3.10.11]
- **Streamlit Version**: [e.g. 1.28.0]
- **Commit Hash / Branch**: [e.g. `main` at `04cc5f2`]
- **Deployment Mode**: [e.g. Local VirtualEnv, Docker, Streamlit Cloud]

## 🔄 Steps to Reproduce
1. Launch app with `streamlit run app.py`
2. Go to section '...'
3. Click on '....'
4. Scroll down to '....'

## 🎯 Expected Behavior
A clear description of what you expected to happen.

## ⚠️ Actual Behavior
A clear description of what actually happened (e.g. error banner, freeze, unexpected value).

## 📋 Sanitized Error Logs / Traceback
```text
Paste sanitized traceback here (ensure API keys and tokens are strictly REDACTED)
```

## 📊 Impact & Severity
- [ ] **S1 — Blocker** (Crash, deadlock, security leak, corrupt data)
- [ ] **S2 — Major** (Core forecasting or validation failure)
- [ ] **S3 — Moderate** (UI glitch, high latency, non-breaking issue)
- [ ] **S4 — Minor** (Cosmetic, typo, minor styling issue)

## 🔁 Reproducibility
- [ ] Always (100% reproducible)
- [ ] Intermittent
- [ ] Only under high load / rate limit
- [ ] Only when offline / disconnected

## 📸 Screenshots (if applicable)
If applicable, attach screenshots to help explain your problem.
